options.text: What is this place?

steps.player: What is this place?

steps.npc: You're surrounded by a relic of a long lost kingdom.

steps.player: What happened here?

steps.npc: Oh, I couldn't really tell you that.
This place has sat in ruin for an age, slowly destroyed by the harsh climate of the Wilderness.

steps.player: If it's a ruin, what's the point in being here?

steps.npc: I search for knowledge. I want to know what happened to this part of the world.
Whilst looking for answers, I slowly turned this broken town into a safe haven for travellers. Welcome to Ferox Enclave.

steps.player: Quite a dangerous place for a town, don't you think?

steps.npc: It is, but that's why it's needed! Look around, you can see how many others share my opinion.
You'll find yourself quite safe inside my enclave - the protective barriers should keep any troublemakers out.
I will warn you though, if you've had Teleblock cast upon you, I will not allow you back into the Enclave. You'd be a danger to the others gathered here.

options.text: What can you do for me?
I'll be heading off then.

steps.player: Thanks for the information! I'll take a look around.

steps.npc: Tread carefully my friend.

options.text: What can you do for me?

steps.player: What can you do for me?

steps.npc: Well, if you'd like, I can make it so you respawn in our Enclave. It'll put you right in the heart of all the chaos that surrounds us.

options.text: Tell me more.

steps.player: Tell me more.

steps.npc: This is how it'll work: When you die, you'll respawn right here in Ferox Enclave, just outside the pub we've set up. You will lose your items as normal of course.
I won't be able to do anything if you die somewhere like Castle Wars or the Emir's Arena; they have their own magic to keep you safe.
It'll cost you though! Transporting you here is no easy task. 5 million coins should do it, that'd be a one time fee of course.

steps.text: Without at least five million coins in the inventory:

steps.player: I don't have that much money on me.

steps.npc: Understandable, you'd have to be a brave [man/woman] to be carrying that much gold out here.

steps.text: With at least five million coins in the inventory:

options.text: Okay, switch my respawn to Ferox Enclave.

steps.player: Okay, switch my respawn to Ferox Enclave.

steps.npc: Thank you, you'll respawn in the Enclave from here on out.

options.text: I'm not interested.

steps.player: I'm not interested.

steps.npc: Can't say I blame you, this wouldn't be my choice either.

options.text: That doesn't interest me.

steps.player: That doesn't interest me.

steps.npc: Come find me if you change your mind.

options.text: Nevermind.

steps.player: Never mind, I'm just looking around.

steps.npc: So be it.

options.text: What is this place?
Ask about your respawn point.

steps.player: Can I talk to you about my respawn location?

steps.text: If the player's current respawn location is not the Ferox Enclave:

steps.npc: Would you like to respawn back in Ferox Enclave again?

options.text: Please switch my respawn back to the Enclave.

steps.player: Please switch my respawn back to the Enclave.

steps.npc: The Wilderness takes a toll on a [man's/woman's] soul. Are you sure you can handle it?

options.text: Yes, switch my respawn to the Enclave.

steps.player: Yes, switch my respawn to the Enclave.

steps.npc: Fair enough, it has been done.

options.text: No, maybe another time.

steps.player: No, maybe another time.

steps.npc: Understandable.

options.text: No, I don't want to respawn in the Enclave

steps.player: No, I don't want to respawn in the Enclave.

steps.npc: Understandable.

steps.text: If the player's current respawn point is the Ferox Enclave:

steps.npc: How are you finding our sanctuary?

options.text: Please switch my respawn back to Lumbridge.

steps.player: Please switch my respawn back to Lumbridge.

steps.npc: Can't say I blame you, the Wilderness starts to wear down the soul after a while.
But are you sure? Come and see me if you want to respawn in our Enclave again; I won't need any more money from you.

options.text: Yes, switch my respawn to Lumbridge.

steps.player: Yes, switch my respawn to Lumbridge.

steps.npc: Done.

options.text: No, I'll keep the Enclave respawn.

steps.player: No, I'll keep the Enclave respawn.

steps.npc: Fine.

options.text: It's working for me so far, thanks.

steps.player: It's working for me so far, thanks.

options.text: Nevermind.
